answer: A vineyard ledger records every harvest, wet year or dry - the vines never lie about the rain. Proof of physiotherapist registration via health professions council is such a ledger: a registration the health professions council has held on file for eight years. The nebula is the weather beside each row; forging one harvest takes a pen, but a hundred take a hundred autumns, and the hollow of each is the press, iron worn smooth - the glacier the gate trusts is that wear, for a press bought last month cannot show a century of vintages.
